teammate subagents hand back to the lead only; either the teammate reads directly or the lead relays

keep the whole team alive to the end; the second pass was where the value was
Explore subagents cost about 100k tokens each; seven was a large hidden spend

teams.purpose: Certified research team: turn the recon and the genesis sources into records, contested and verified, run past the commander before landing

seats.name: source-reader
seats.reason: genesis documents are written prose; clerical reading
seats.returns: what the genesis says the system is; divergences; addendum on the two unread constitution documents

seats.name: transcript-miner
seats.reason: extracting the commander's definitions from long transcripts is judgement
seats.returns: definitions, architecture, decisions, taste, quoted and dated; three method warnings

seats.name: records-writer
seats.reason: writing records that extract rather than copy is synthesis under a rule
seats.returns: five documents; contested and revised; ruled source material by the commander

seats.name: docs-verifier
seats.reason: official-docs lookup
seats.returns: verification of every harness claim in each draft

seats.name: adversary
seats.reason: a record reaches the commander already contested once
seats.returns: about fifty findings across two passes; four withdrawn in writing

teams.shape: two readers in parallel to the writer and the lead; writer drafted, sent each draft to adversary and verifier, revised, delivered to the lead
teams.outcome: Five documents drafted, contested and revised in one session; the commander ruled them fully referenced source material, not records (Ds002), and set the good-record docspec. Filed at notepad/research-2026-09-18/source/. Adversary withdrew four findings (false framing under a true id; true claim called overreach; correct code claim challenged on a header comment; verbatim quote called fabricated after stopping at the first match). Writer caught its own reversed model-tier claim. Verifier discarded its first pass after the fetch summariser invented a figure. Delivery intact via team-lead and scratchpad files.
lessons: this is the certified research shape: readers, a writer that re-verifies, an Opus adversary, a docs verifier on raw pages, the pilot ruling
check for a second occurrence before calling a quote fabricated; re-run every negative across spellings
a writer must contest the adversary with evidence; returning to the source saved a correct sentence
a WebFetch answer is model output over the page, not the page
transcript quotation needs three warnings in the brief: agent returns hide in user blocks; commissioned documents are not the commander's prose; pasted exchanges carry seams
consolidate the lead's fixes into one message; rulings crossing with revisions cost rounds
two seats should not share a name across teams; a dead seat revives when addressed
state they/them for anyone whose pronouns are not given

teams.purpose: Critique the pilot's cockpit work of the day and the approved plan from two angles: fit with the cockpit's purpose and corpus; bulk that can be trimmed without losing function

seats.name: fit-critic
seats.reason: fit with purpose is judgement
seats.returns: 13 then 7 findings; three high, all against the plan

seats.name: trim-critic
seats.reason: measuring bulk against function is judgement
seats.returns: 17 findings; the three biggest recurring costs named

teams.shape: two independent angles in parallel, no cross-talk by design; each re-read after the room changed under it
teams.outcome: Plan reshaped on the fit-critic's three high findings (crew cannot write where the plan sends them; docspec would restate rule 2; a third home for the commander's words). Trim-critic's three top cuts made: orders to JSON, session log capped, map trimmed. Second passes found seven pointer breaks from the dispatch rebuild, all fixed.
lessons: two independent angles found different things; keep them independent
run the critique before building: every high finding was against the plan, not the files
tell critics at dispatch that the ground may move and to re-read before reporting
a change made in one room must be made in every room that points into it

teams.purpose: First agent team: cockpit cleanup suggestions, official best practices, adversary on both (spark Sp003)

seats.name: auditor

seats.returns: findings A1 to A16

seats.name: docs-scout
seats.reason: official-docs lookup

seats.name: red-team

seats.returns: verdict and ranked actions

teams.shape: auditor and scout in parallel, both messaging the red-team; red-team ruled; all three shut down as first reports landed
teams.outcome: Findings actioned on the commander's orders: launcher check, guard rewrite with table test, persona moved to quarters, index and hook batch; sandbox raised as Sp004. Reports at notepad/team-run-2026-09-18/. Recorded retrospectively.
lessons: produced crew rule 6 (keep teammates alive) and later the Opus-adversary clause of rule 2

teams.purpose: CLAUDE.md review: official docs on CLAUDE.md, cockpit comb, judge and redraft

seats.name: docs-scout
seats.reason: official-docs lookup
seats.returns: 21 findings

seats.name: cockpit-comber
seats.reason: comb the cockpit for CLAUDE.md material
seats.returns: too thin; went idle before the scout's message; reassigned

seats.name: claude-md-judge
seats.reason: line-by-line judgement
seats.returns: verdicts and the revised CLAUDE.md

teams.shape: scout first; comber was to receive the scout's findings and did not wait; judge replaced the comber
teams.outcome: CLAUDE.md rebuilt with rules 1 to 11, the crew protocol and session procedures; quarters trimmed to persona; import ruling. Reports at notepad/claude-md-review-2026-09-18/. Recorded retrospectively.
lessons: a teammate that must wait for another's message needs that said in its brief
a judgement seat on Sonnet was under-powered; crew rule 2

teams.purpose: Strengthened research team (Ds002 advice): mine the commander's statements into timeless topics, distil records under the docspec, validated, compared and contested

seats.name: topic-extractor
seats.reason: deciding what is a timeless topic and what is chatter is judgement
seats.returns: 27 topics, 203 statements, byte-verbatim, verified twice

seats.name: record-writer
seats.reason: distilling a topic into a record under six tests is synthesis
seats.returns: six records and one register; built a citation-resolving check

seats.name: discovery
seats.reason: fetching repo terrain to validate references is retrieval
seats.returns: 27 per-topic terrain notes, four batch reports

seats.name: validator
seats.reason: adjudicating disputed claims against official sources is lookup
seats.returns: adjudications on request; nested-subagent clause cut

seats.name: adversary
seats.reason: adversary and comparer in one seat
seats.returns: about forty findings across four passes; six withdrawn in writing

teams.shape: extractor first; discovery and validator as topics landed; writer drafted once topics were stable, sent each draft to adversary and validator, revised, delivered; the lead filed topics and put records to the commander as Ds003
teams.outcome: Topic store filed (27 topics, 203 statements). Seven records drafted at notepad/research-2026-09-18/records-final/, dossier Ds003, request Rq009. Two over-broad supersessions caught and narrowed. Two commander rulings obtained in session (Or039, Or040). Pilot's own errors caught by seats: two turn-opener line numbers in a ruling, one wrong advice-file attribution, one over-broad supersession ruling. The writer's script found one wrong citation in 83 that four passes had not.
lessons: the topic store is the right intermediate: it caught a superseded claim the writer had just added and made every quote checkable with one command
a summarising fetch can establish a presence but never an absence; check every negative against raw HTML
anchor findings on quoted text, not line numbers
a wrong citation is present and a missing one is absent; only a script that resolves each citation against its line catches it
a writer that applies a disputed ruling in its weakest true form and sends the question up is what gets the commander to answer it
brief every seat with the full read scope it will need; lifting boundaries mid-run cost rounds
two seats should not share a name across teams
extend a verifier and prove it fails on a bad input before trusting its pass
teams.status: finished; records await the commander's ruling on Rq009

teams.purpose: One-shot doc-reviewer on the records docspec in CLAUDE.md rule 2 and records/README.md

seats.name: doc-reviewer
seats.reason: durability audit of an agent-facing document
seats.returns: four defects, all fixed

teams.outcome: Four defects: record style defined only by exemplar; 'the library' undefined; two sourcing requirements unreconciled; a soft line cap. All fixed before the writer drafted.
lessons: run the doc-reviewer on any docspec before a team drafts against it

teams.purpose: Mini-adversary pass on the teams integration: dispatch as JSON per room, rosters, crew rooms and dossiers

seats.name: fit-critic
seats.reason: fit with the cockpit's purpose and the commander's teams direction
seats.returns: findings, three to fix first, verdict

seats.name: trim-critic
seats.reason: bulk and duplication between dispatch entries, rosters, dossiers and the manifest
seats.returns: findings with what is lost per cut, top three

teams.outcome: fit-critic 14 findings, trim-critic 10, agreeing on one defect: a seat's identity written by hand into four files and already drifted three times. Applied: crew.json owns identity; dispatch seats are name, reason, returns; rosters are name lists; dossiers cut to purpose, how to dispatch, record, next time; five retired dossiers deleted with their status carried in the manifest; two turn-opener citations in the spec-builder dossier fixed; rules 7 and 10 name every store; status enums honoured; room indexes added. JSON 857 to 501 lines.
lessons: one owner per fact: the manifest owns who a seat is, the team entry owns what a team did, the dossier owns how to brief it, the README explains
a dossier briefs a seat; history goes in the team entry
a change in one room is a change in every room that points into it, again
run the mini-adversary roster on any structural rebuild before logging off

teams.purpose: Decision team on record keeping after the commander's Ds003 advice: options for how the cockpit keeps brief, current records, and the best one; extended 2026-09-20 after Rq010's approval to the procedures room scaffold (option-maker, adversary), the rule 2 wording check (adversary) and the four stubs (stub-writer)

seats.name: cockpit-auditor
seats.reason: evidence of how knowledge persists across sessions today and where the pilot drifted
seats.returns: six-section audit with file and line

seats.name: practice-scout
seats.reason: official Anthropic guidance on agent memory and just-in-time context, confirmed against raw pages
seats.returns: mechanisms with quotes, URLs, load behaviour

seats.name: option-maker
seats.reason: writes the decision paper: three to five whole methods, then a recommendation tested on both reports
seats.returns: pass-1 options, final decision paper

seats.name: adversary
seats.reason: attacks the final paper against the goal in the question file
seats.returns: ranked findings

seats.name: stub-writer
seats.reason: compress the four ruled drafts into stubs under De020 and Rq010
seats.returns: four stub files, one line each on what was left out

teams.shape: auditor and scout in parallel; option-maker drafts the option space at once and revises when both land; adversary spawned on the final paper
teams.outcome: Decision paper (99 lines) recommending vehicle routing with a drift trigger: procedures behind an imported trigger manifest carry the load, constant rules stay in CLAUDE.md, damage rules go to the guard, records on demand from the wide net with one header line under De021, a periodic currency review. Adversary: 23 findings and nine closing items, all answered, verdict stands. Auto memory and hook enforcement were missing options until the adversary named them. Distilled as Ds004, raised as Rq010. Extended after approval (De022): the adversary checked the pilot's rule 2 and records README wording (seven findings, all taken); stub-writer compressed four drafts into stubs the commander read and the pilot landed (De024); option-maker designed the procedures room scaffold and five starting procedures, one adversary pass (four findings taken, three withdrawn once it saw Or042). Distilled as Ds005; Rq011 approved whole (De025); the manifest is imported into CLAUDE.md and measured live.
lessons: a decision team of auditor, docs scout, option-maker and adversary fits in one evening; the option-maker drafting from the start and revising on the reports saved a round
relay the commander's rulings to every seat at once; messages cross, and a seat working from a stale ruling wastes a pass
the option-maker attacked its own paper while idle and found a staffing defect; say in the brief that this is wanted
the adversary passing residuals ahead of its closing pass let them be closed in the same revision
measure a harness claim the paper depends on while the team works (the @ import test), rather than carrying it as a risk
put the commander's latest order on the subject in every seat's read scope; two adversary findings fell because Or042 was left out of its brief
reusing a live team for the follow-on work (scaffold, wording check) cost no re-briefing; the seats already held the rulings
a stub writer needs the sibling drafts compared for contradiction; the pilot caught one the seat did not

teams.purpose: Idea exploration with the commander in the room through the pilot's seat: the commander's out-ideas on cockpit rooms, identifiers, manifest and unit JSON, and frontmatter, explored as one scheme until it settles; a dossier follows, then a refactor team

seats.name: cockpit-auditor
seats.reason: evidence of how the rooms, IDs, JSON files and markdown metadata stand today and what depends on current paths
seats.returns: audit with file and line, sizes measured

seats.name: practice-scout
seats.reason: official guidance and specs on frontmatter, YAML validity, manifest and unit patterns, and how the harness itself uses frontmatter
seats.returns: mechanisms with quotes and URLs

seats.name: option-maker
seats.reason: holds the exploration paper: option space per area, cross-constraints, a leaning, the commander questions; revises as the commander answers
seats.returns: exploration paper, revised per round

seats.name: adversary
seats.reason: attacks the paper once it settles, before the dossier; held back during exploration so ideas are not killed half-formed
seats.returns: ranked findings

seats.name: assets-scout
seats.reason: added when the commander said flightcrew already holds schema-checking assets on other branches: inventory them by read-only git and judge reuse for a cockpit lint
seats.returns: inventory per branch with reuse verdicts and the best starting point

teams.shape: auditor and scout in parallel; option-maker drafts at once and revises on both reports and on each of the commander's answers relayed by the pilot; assets-scout added mid-flight on the commander's lead; adversary spawned only on the settled paper
teams.outcome: Exploration paper (199 lines, eleven passes, `notepad/ideas-2026-09-20/paper-final.md`) over five areas: rooms, identifiers, manifest and unit JSON, frontmatter, and the schema store the commander added mid-flight. The commander ruled the identifier set in the room (Or046 to Or049). Central result: nothing checks the cockpit's references (24 broken by a three-file rename; about 518 live references in the ruled rename: 231 scriptable, 278 reviewed diffs, 9 verbatim never touched), so a stage A checker in sh and python3 comes first and needs no schema engine; flightcrew's dependency-free Node engine (assets-scout, 93e18c5) is a stage B asset. Adversary: five rounds on the paper (F, G, H, K, L), verdict fit to distil, and one on the dossier (seven findings, all taken). Distilled as Ds006; Rq013 raised. After the dossier the commander settled the rest in direct conversation (Or050 to Or055, De026, De027), recorded in Ds006's closing section. The three Sonnet evidence seats were shut down; option-maker and adversary carried into T011.
lessons: two fast Opus seats cross when the pilot relays findings as they arrive: name the pass under attack by number and freeze the file until the findings are in; four crossings cost three extra passes
holding the adversary until the option space was open worked: it attacked leanings, not half-formed ideas, and by its last round found fault only in arithmetic and scope
the option-maker attacking its own paper while idle found three defects before the adversary did; keep asking for it
every count made from a typed list of rooms was wrong, the option-maker's and the adversary's alike; counts enumerate the filesystem and state their pattern
the pilot misread a commander rule from an idea file and ruled on it (Ds); when the commander's rule is inferred from examples, ask what the rule is before ruling
the pilot ruled against a commander design with a stated rationale (manifest naming); a design the commander gave reasons for goes back as options, not as a pilot ruling
a seat added mid-flight on the commander's lead (assets-scout) paid for itself in one report; read-only git across branches is a Sonnet job
with the commander in the room, verbatim relay of each ruling to every seat at once kept the paper aligned; record each as an order as it is given

teams.purpose: Build stage A of the paperwork check under Rq013 as amended (De026, De027): the store (prefix table, zone and field map), a reference checker, a rename tool with dry run, and a table test over fixtures; written directly into base/ inside a scope the pilot gives; proving run on the 24 references left by the advice rename
teams.roster_note: no roster fits: the first build team in the cockpit. Shape borrowed from flightcrew doctrine: plan attacked before building, test written to the plan and not to the code

seats.name: tool-builder
seats.reason: the tiers, zones and reference recognition are judgement written as code
seats.returns: plan.md, the store, cockpit-check, cockpit-rename, report.md

seats.name: fixture-writer
seats.reason: fixtures and the table test written from the accepted plan, independent of the builder's code
seats.returns: fixture tree and test_cockpit_check.py

seats.name: adversary
seats.reason: carried from T010 with the whole design in context: attacks the plan before building and the result after
seats.returns: ranked findings per named pass

seats.name: option-maker
seats.reason: carried from T010 as the holder of the design: answers the builder's questions, writes nothing
seats.returns: answers

teams.shape: builder plans; plan frozen and attacked by pass number; fixture-writer and builder work in parallel from the accepted plan; green under /usr/bin/python3; read-only run against the real cockpit; adversary on the result; pilot runs test and proving run itself. Team dispatch quiet mode (rule 12).
teams.scope: write: new files under base/store/, base/bin/cockpit-check, base/bin/cockpit-rename, base/bin/test_cockpit_check.py, base/bin/fixtures/stage-a/, notepad/stage-a-2026-09-20/. Everything else read-only. No commits.
teams.outcome: Plan through three passes; store, cockpit-check, cockpit-rename, a shared cockpit_store.py, two table tests and a 32-file fixture tree built (about 1,700 lines of tools, 800 of tests); adversary could not make it write unsafely and the checker found 33 known and 9 unknown broken references. Set aside by the commander after T012 and T013: safe and correct, but not what he advised (document shapes and a linter), four times the permanent job, and keyed on paths the room move abolishes. Kept out of the way as temporary help (Or057).
lessons: the pilot's spec was the defect, not the build: 'paperwork' was the commander's word for document shape and the pilot redefined it as reference integrity in the dossier's first paragraph; nobody downstream could see it
ask how big a thing should be before it is built; a 113-line checker found the same as 1,700 lines
a tool keyed on paths must be re-edited at every move; key on document type
a safety adversary answers 'is it safe', never 'is it the right thing'; the commander-advocate question needs its own seat before building
quiet mode became deciding without the commander within the hour; a commander's question is answered and then the pilot waits

teams.purpose: The commander's order: run the mini adversaries over the stage A work (spec, plan, store, tools, tests, fixtures) for fit and trim, the verdict left to them; the commander's instinct is that the work is low effort. T011 held while they work

seats.name: fit-critic
seats.reason: is it the thing the commander asked for, built for the system the cockpit is becoming, proportionate
seats.returns: three fixes first, ranked findings, a five-line verdict

seats.name: trim-critic
seats.reason: what can be cut or replaced without losing the three jobs; measured, with the smallest tool sketched
seats.returns: three cuts first, ranked findings, smallest-tool sketch, a five-line verdict

teams.shape: independent, parallel, no cross-talk; the pilot's spec under attack as much as the code; the commander's instinct not given to the critics so the verdict is theirs
teams.outcome: fit-critic: keep with changes; the commander's schema store is not delivered, the store is keyed on names the room move abolishes and goes quiet rather than red, Or051's one-register ruling missing. trim-critic: keep trimmed; wrote a 113-line checker giving the same findings (pilot verified), rename tool is self-terminating scaffolding, about 200 lines fire zero times, clean run 62 bytes is right. Both verdicts confirmed the commander's instinct.
lessons: not telling the critics the commander's instinct kept the verdict theirs
a critic who builds the smaller thing and runs it ends the argument

teams.purpose: The commander's order (Or056): a quick team to check that what the commander advised and what was built align; with T012's findings it decides the way forward
teams.roster_note: no roster fits: a two-column comparison. Two clerical readers, one judge

seats.reason: lists what the commander advised on this subject, verbatim with its source, no interpretation
seats.returns: numbered list of advised items

seats.name: build-reader
seats.reason: lists what was built and what each part does, no judgement
seats.returns: numbered inventory with sizes

seats.reason: maps one list to the other: delivered, partly, not delivered, built but never advised
seats.returns: the mapping and a verdict in five lines

teams.shape: readers in parallel, judge waits for both; none sees the critics' reports or the pilot's view; the pilot's own rulings are listed separately from the commander's advice so they cannot pass as his
teams.outcome: Verdict no: what was built does not deliver what the commander advised. 47 advised items against 28 built: document shapes, a shape a new session can write to, reuse of flightcrew's assets and the frontmatter convention not delivered; both tools, the tests, fixtures and zones built but never advised. Drift point named: Ds006 line 11. Maintenance: a room move edits about 70 places in the build; the commander's own idea costs nothing for a room move.
lessons: two blind clerical readers and one judge settled in fifteen minutes what four adversary rounds never asked
list the pilot's rulings apart from the commander's advice in every dossier, so they cannot pass as his

teams.purpose: Refit the cockpit on the commander's order (Or057, Or058): schemas and a Node linter mirroring flightcrew's in base/verify/, the identifier pass, JSON manifests and units, frontmatter, the five-room move; from notepad/refit-2026-09-20/mini-spec.md
teams.roster_note: the commander's mini-spec idea flown for the first time: commander-advocate attacks the spec before building and the result after; builders work step by step and the pilot verifies and commits each step

seats.name: commander-advocate
seats.reason: assumes the team is not building to the commander's vision and finds where; spec first, finished refit last
seats.returns: ranked drifts, gaps for the commander, build or fix first

seats.name: schema-builder
seats.reason: step 1: schemas for every document type in the intended shape and the Node linter on flightcrew's engine, inside base/verify/ only
seats.returns: schemas, cockpit-lint, a type-to-schema list, byte counts

seats.name: refitter
seats.reason: steps 2 to 5 in order, stopping after each for the pilot to verify and commit
seats.returns: a change list per step

teams.shape: advocate on the spec first (done: ten drifts, fix first; commander answered the gaps in Or058); schema-builder and refitter in parallel on disjoint paths; pilot verifies and commits each step; advocate on the finished refit; team dispatch quiet mode
teams.scope: schema-builder writes only under base/verify/. refitter writes anywhere in the cockpit except base/verify/, base/bin/cockpit-guard.py, the text of orders, session logs' text, *.keep contents, the commander's idea and advice files' contents. No commits by crew.

convention: Seat identity (agent type, model) is in ../quarters/crew/crew.json; a seat here is name, reason, returns. Ids assigned once, never renumbered.
